title: evaluation.failed.v1
description: Evaluation could not run. Separate from insufficient evidence, which is an answer; this is the absence of one. Conflating them would tell a candidate their interview was inconclusive when in fact a provider was down.

failure.description: The taxonomy an operator acts on. Budget exhaustion is separate from provider failure because one is answered by spending and the other by waiting.

retryable.description: Whether the same attempt could succeed unchanged. Stated by the producer rather than inferred from the failure, so that a consumer is not left encoding our taxonomy.
